description: 臺灣活動斷層分布圖(五十萬分之一比例尺數值檔) [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 本資料集是以WMS服務（ gsmma. gov. tw/mapguide/mapagent/mapagent. fcgi? version=1. 0. 0&format=image/png）提供，請將下載檔案所示的網址加入GIS軟體（如QGIS）中，即可在目錄選取本圖層。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
